comment: The devlog index. One entry per post. Posts are generated by postforge as SvelteKit routes under src/routes/devlog/<slug>/ so they inherit the site's navbar, footer and layout rather than carrying a copy of them.

entries.title: The Easier Question
entries.dek: Four times in one working session a check came back green while the thing it was supposed to prove stayed false. Every one of them failed the same way.
